images.caption: Night attention study
images.alt: Two overlapping Night theme desktop windows with activity, candidate and keyboard focus marks.
images.prompt: A polished desktop UI design study, landscape composition, Night theme for Warlock. Two overlapping opaque near-black windows on matte black desktop, restrained ivory text and deep red accents. Focused window has ivory edge and stable title beacon, a separate inset red application activity contour, another candidate has ivory corner brackets, receiving window has blue paired chevrons and a blue focus ring around a control. Exact text only: Settings, Appearance, Night, Dawn. Precise flat surfaces, generous spacing, no extra text, no logos, no photography.

images.caption: Dawn attention study
images.alt: Two overlapping Dawn theme desktop windows with activity, candidate and keyboard focus marks.
images.prompt: Create the Dawn theme companion to this UI illustration. Keep exactly the same composition, positions, scale, windows, shapes and exact labels Settings, Appearance, Night, Dawn. Change only the palette to warm paper background #F6F1EA, opaque warm white windows, dark ink #181314, deep red #A11D22 and blue focus #14539A. Use clean sans-serif typography. No new text or controls.
